In approximately [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]],<ref name="NEC date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the expedition from [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] was launched in [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]].</ref> a famous '''Jedi Master''' blessed an expedition of three [[Starship/Legends|starships]]&mdash;''[[Beneficent Tasia]]'', ''[[Constant]]'', and ''[[Mother Vima]]''&mdash;departing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] dangerous southern quadrant. The expedition was sponsored by Grizmallt's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]]<ref name="GB" /> and carried [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Grizmallti/Legends|Grizmallti]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from a [[Grizmallti civil war/Legends|civil war]] on Grizmallt. The refugees<ref name="Nexus">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> eventually landed on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] it.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The famous [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was mentioned in the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal Naboo]] DataBank entry in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The ship ''Mother Vima'', which was named ''Mother Sunrider'' in the game's French edition, shares part of its name<ref name="GB" /> with [[Vima Sunrider]], a character who was introduced in the [[Tales of the Jedi 3|third issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series, which was written by [[Tom Veitch]]<ref name="Tales">[[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]]</ref> and published on [[December 21]], [[1993]].<ref>{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54568/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_1993_3|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (1993) #3}}</ref> [[In-universe]], Sunrider was [[Old Sith Wars|active]] in the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] prior to the expedition from Grizmallt and regarded as one of the greatest [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of her age.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
